title: Stack
description: Flex layout primitives (Stack, HStack, VStack) with token-based gaps, optional separators and attached groups. Children are not wrapped in item elements.

basic.title: Vertical stack
basic.description: VStack stacks children in a column and stretches them by default.

horizontal.title: Horizontal stack
horizontal.description: HStack centers items on the cross axis; justify distributes them.

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: Numbers select spacing tokens (2 = 8px, 4 = 16px, 6 = 24px); other strings are CSS lengths.

wrap.title: Wrap and semantics
wrap.description: wrap lets items flow onto new lines; as renders a list.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: separator is rendered between items, such as a vertical Divider; empty children get none.

attached.title: Attached group
attached.description: attached joins items into one group with shared borders and outer corners only, like a segmented control.

StackProps.gap: Gap between items: numbers and numeric strings select spacing tokens, other strings are CSS values. No gap when omitted.
StackProps.separator: Rendered between every two items (not before the first or after the last); empty children get no separator
StackProps.attached: Joins the items into one attached group: no gap, shared borders, outer-only corner radii and role="group"
